youtube_short.title: Your Black Friday Deal Is Fake
title_alternatives: How Black Friday Steals $1,400 From You Every Year
The Price Inflation Trick Behind Every Black Friday Sale
youtube_short.description: 92% of Black Friday 'deals' are cheaper or the same price at other times of year — and retailers spend months engineering the trap. They quietly inflate prices in October, then 'slash' them back on Black Friday while your FOMO brain can't think straight. The average shopper plans $200 and spends $496. Over the holiday season, that's $1,400 more than you budgeted. Here's the simple hack to beat it. #BlackFriday #personalfinance #moneytips #savemoney
